When was Jeffrey Archer Born?

Jeffrey Archer was born on April 15th, 1940.

When did Jeffrey Archer die?

Jeffrey Archer died on October 5th, 2026 at 86 years old.

Where was Jeffrey Archer Born?

Jeffrey Archer was born in Holloway, London, England.

What awards has Jeffrey Archer won?

Jeffrey Archer has won the following awards: Honorary Platinum Bestseller Award at the Nielsen Awards (2022).

What was the first book Jeffrey Archer wrote?

The first book written by Jeffrey Archer was Not a Penny More, Not a Penny Less, published in 1976.

What was the most recent book Jeffrey Archer wrote?

His most recently released work was Adam and Eve on October 6th, 2026.

What is the most popular book by Jeffrey Archer?

Based on the number of readers on Book Notification, the most popular Jeffrey Archer book is Nothing Ventured. Here are his most popular books and their average ratings:
  1. Nothing Ventured (7.96)
  2. Only Time Will Tell (8.21)

What genres does Jeffrey Archer Write?

Jeffrey Archer primarily writes in the Children's Books, Crime Fiction, Historical Fiction, and Thriller genres. His work includes sub-genres such as Police Procedural, Spy / Espionage Thriller, and Political Thriller.

How many books has Jeffrey Archer written?

Jeffrey Archer has written 63 books across 11 series and categories, excluding contributions to anthologies.
  • 3 books in the Kane and Abel Series
  • 7 books in The Clifton Chronicles Series
  • 8 books in the Detective William Warwick Series
  • 14 Standalone Novels
  • 8 Short Stories/Novellas
  • 1 Play
  • 4 Children's Books
  • 12 Short Story Collections
  • 1 Non-Fiction Books
  • 3 books in the A Prison Diary Non-Fiction Series
  • 2 books in the Little Kingdoms Series
